# LUFT

> A Motion Studies research study of a recorded day of aircraft movement over Europe, revealing routes, airport rhythms, and accumulating traces.

## Study

- [LUFT](https://luft.motionstudies.app/): Interactive playback of observed aircraft movement over Europe.
- [Motion Studies](https://motionstudies.app/): The catalogue and approach to scheduled, observed, and reconstructed movement.

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/emmettl/luft): Study source code and documentation.
